title: Herbed Ukrainian Rice Fried-Rice
description: A peppery, herbed fried rice that recalls Ukrainian kitchen memories, brightened by a subtle sweetness from rice syrup and a tang from jocheong.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and melt the butter until foamy.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, diced carrot, and frozen peas, cooking for another 2 minutes.
Add the scallion greens, smoked paprika, and fresh herbs, sautéing for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the cooked rice, breaking up clumps with a spatula, and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Drizzle the soy sauce and honey or rice syrup over the rice, tossing to coat evenly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, adjusting as needed for flavor.
Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the rice is hot and slightly crispy on the bottom, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 1 minute before serving.
Garnish with extra fresh herbs if desired and serve immediately.
